findings.body: The previous gap remains: the between-refresh elapsed assertion, nullable worker-start case and stage-outcome assertions in core.test.ts are not executed by the repository suite. forge.toml:6 and .github/workflows/forge-next.yml:58 run pytest; tests/test_mod_plugin.py:54 type-checks the native tests but never executes them. These regressions could therefore pass the supplied close run. SHIP owns the native plugin test job (plans/FORGE-MOD-1.md:284), which must run `claude plugin test` and propagate failures. This remains deferred advice under the task ownership rule.
findings.title: Later: SHIP must run the native CORE regression tests
